title: Compact Metrics Toggle: keyboard-first color-contrast and pluralization readiness
creator: Leah Park
description: Goal: Replace current dense metric-toggle used in rollouts and cost cards with a keyboard-first, localization-ready component that meets WCAG AA+ contrast for text/icons, provides explicit focus states, and supports ICU-style pluralization and RTL layout. Deliverables: final component spec (tokens, states, aria roles), high-fidelity prototype in Figma, implementation notes for engineering (focus management, DOM order for screen-readers), and a QA checklist for automated and manual tests across locales.
acceptance_criteria: Updated toggle component meets 4.5:1 contrast for label text on all supported background tokens
Keyboard flow: toggle reachable in logical order via Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow-keys toggle when grouped, focus ring follows design tokens
Screen reader announces label + state succinctly (e.g., 'Cost view: compact, collapsed') and supports aria-live for dynamic rollouts
Localized labels use ICU message syntax; plural forms and number formatting verified for en/zh/es/ar/ja
RTL: toggle flips visually and DOM order preserves reading order; no clipping of focus outlines in narrow containers
Prototype validated with internal a11y review and two user research sessions with keyboard-only participants
design_notes: We explored two approaches: (A) single semantic button with aria-pressed plus visible check/indicator; (B) toggle-group with role="radiogroup" + radio buttons. Recommendation: Option A for compactness and simpler focus handling; implement secondary offscreen label for screen readers to expose the full semantics (state + context). Use existing color tokens: surface-01, text-default, interactive-strong; adjust interactive-strong to reach 4.5:1 against surface-01 at all theme modes. Add 2px high-contrast focus ring using focus-accent token. For locale text, adopt ICU pluralization patterns and prefer abbreviated localized strings in compact layouts with long-form tooltip for hover/focus.
proposed_color_pairs: text-muted on surface-02 (3.8:1) -- avoid for primary labels
engineering_notes: Implement as a single <button> with aria-pressed; update JS to emit analytics event 'toggle_compact_metrics' with variant and locale
Focus management: when opening rollout flyout, autofocus first interactive element; maintain Tab order between toggle and adjacent menu items
Ensure no reliance on color alone: add icon + change in label for state change
Testing: add Axe/Pa11y checks in CI for contrast and missing ARIA; unit tests for ICU message rendering using formatjs locale fixtures
Backward compat: provide feature flag 'compact-toggle-v2' for gradual rollout; fallback to old DOM structure when flag off
qa_checklist: Contrast verification across light/dark themes and high-contrast mode
Keyboard-only walkthrough of console rollouts page (Tab sequence, arrow key interactions)
Screen reader sweep with VoiceOver and NVDA for en/zh/ar
Locale verification: validate pluralization for sample counts (0,1,2,5,11,21 depending on locale rules)
RTL visual check: focus rings not clipped; tooltip positioning flips appropriately
E2E smoke test to ensure analytics event fires and release flag toggles behavior
